issues.text: The blocked-email lookup does a case-sensitive string comparison, so changing the case of one letter in a blocked address bypasses the block entirely.
issues.zh: 封鎖名單的 email 比對是大小寫敏感的字串相等，改一個字母的大小寫就能繞過整個機制。

issues.text: should_block? is a query-named predicate method that also writes to the database (updates match_count/last_match_at), and because validation runs twice per registration attempt (valid? then save), the counter is incremented twice for a single attempt.
issues.zh: BlockedEmail.should_block? 把「查詢」和「更新統計」綁在同一個以 ? 結尾的方法裡，是隱性副作用；一次註冊嘗試會被呼叫兩次，match_count 每次多加一。

issues.text: match_count is incremented via a non-atomic read-modify-write, so concurrent registration requests can lose an increment (race condition).
issues.zh: match_count 用 read-modify-write 累加，沒有原子性，兩個同時進來的請求會遺失一次更新。

issues.text: The return value of record.save when updating match_count is discarded, so if the save ever fails validation, the stats silently stop updating with no signal.
issues.zh: record.save 的回傳值被丟棄，一旦驗證失敗，統計就會安靜地停止更新，沒有任何訊號。

issues.text: rejectedEmails is declared in the class body, so the Ember.A([]) array actually lives on the prototype and is shared across all controller instances.
issues.zh: rejectedEmails 宣告在 class body，陣列實際掛在 prototype 上被所有 instance 共用。

issues.text: The new errors field in the POST /users response is a hash keyed by field name, which has the same name but a different shape than the existing errors (a string array) used elsewhere in the same controller.
issues.zh: POST /users 新增的 errors 是以欄位為 key 的 hash，和同一個 controller 既有的 errors（字串陣列）同名不同形狀。

issues.text: The field-level error message shown for a blocked email is a generic "invalid", inconsistent with the specific server message shown in the flash.
issues.zh: 被擋下的 email 在欄位上顯示通用的「invalid」，和 flash 顯示的伺服器訊息不一致。

issues.text: The new EmailValidator uses the `and` keyword instead of `&&` in a conditional, which is a low-precedence pitfall.
issues.zh: 新增的 EmailValidator 條件式用 and，優先權低於 =，這個習慣在有賦值的條件式裡會安靜地算錯。

issues.text: The new EmailValidator file is missing a trailing newline at end of file.
set_defaults is declared as a public instance method even though it is only meant to be used as an internal before_validation callback.
issues.zh: set_defaults 是 public callback，等於對外承諾了一個沒人該呼叫的 API。

issues.text: should_block? returns nil instead of false when no matching record exists, violating the predicate-method (?) convention of always returning a boolean.
issues.zh: should_block? 在查無資料時回傳的是 nil，而不是 false，以 ? 結尾的方法回傳非布林值。

issues.text: The new BlockedEmail model name collides conceptually with the existing User#blocked concept (suspended accounts), which refers to something different.
issues.zh: BlockedEmail 這個名字和既有的 User#blocked（被停權的既有帳號）概念撞名。

issues.text: There is no test coverage for EmailValidator's short-circuit branch that skips should_block? when the email already has other validation errors.
issues.zh: EmailValidator:13 的短路條件（已經有 email 錯誤時不呼叫 should_block?）沒有測試。

issues.text: There is no test coverage for the new errors/values response fields added to UsersController that the frontend depends on.
issues.zh: users_controller 新增的 errors / values 回應欄位也沒有測試。

open_questions.text: How will the blocked_emails table actually be populated, given there is no admin UI, rake task, or seed data to insert records?
open_questions.zh: blocked_emails 這張表要怎麼被填資料？這張 MR 是刻意只做執行路徑、資料來源留給後續，還是漏了？

open_questions.text: Should a blocked registration attempt reveal to the requester that the specific email address is on the block list, since the current response allows enumerating the list?
open_questions.zh: 被封鎖的註冊該不該讓對方看出「這個地址在名單上」？現在的回應足以讓人逐一列舉名單內容。
